properties.rationale: Avoids building a large analyzer platform before proving value.

entries.label: Evidence freshness is computed once and shared by reconcile and the evidence_required rule

properties.rationale: Conformance must not count stale evidence; one implementation avoids two answers.

entries.label: Policies are declarative rule records in the snapshot, evaluated by built-in rule types

properties.rationale: Keeps policy as versioned data that cannot execute code; new rule types are tool changes, not policy edits.

entries.label: Scope closure = explicit members, their structural children, realized requirements, applicable constraints, global constraints, and concerning questions, decisions and assumptions

properties.rationale: Deterministic and explainable; every closure member records why it is included. Shared containers do not propagate realized requirements, so one component serving two features does not merge their scopes.

entries.label: One canonical snapshot with transactions inside it; no daemon

properties.rationale: Atomic writes and straightforward recovery before sharding; graph state and transaction accounting cannot diverge.

properties.rationale: Keeps evidence inputs inspectable and versioned with the model without hashing the whole repository.

sections.title: Which rules, assumptions and decisions matter?

entries.label: Which readiness rules are mandatory by default?

properties.answer: v0 default policy: structural checks pass; blocking questions resolved; accepted requirements realized or deliberately deferred; operations define inputs, outputs and failures; concurrency-sensitive processes reviewed; no refuted assumptions; review packet current. Projects override by setting their own policy.

entries.label: Which readiness obligations are mandatory by default versus project-specific?

properties.answer: See question:default-mandatory-rules; answered for v0 by the default policy.

entries.label: How much trust does an independent capture earn when the command is user-supplied?

properties.answer: v0: independent_capture means the tool ran the argv and recorded exit code and output; the command's meaning is still the submitter's claim, recorded in declared inputs and limitations.
